task: Report the listed titles on one supported public careers board and whether a later observation changed them. A source failure is not an empty board.
consumer: An agent that already has, or can be given, one supported board's public JSON and needs a repeatable coverage class.

directAlternative: Read title and externalPath or jobUrl from HTTP 200 jobPostings or jobs. Treat a non-200 response as transport failure, not as an empty board. Do not build the absolute Workday URL or coverage accounting.
